overridesReason: React Native tolerates exactly ONE copy of React. @expo/ui declares react 19.2.8 as a direct dependency while Expo SDK 57 pins 19.2.3, so npm installs both — and two React instances cause 'Invalid hook call' crashes at runtime, not a build error. The overrides below collapse the tree to a single copy. Re-check on every Expo SDK upgrade.
